We need answer only valid JSON. Need produce concise architecture plan <=2000 words. Keys specified. Need construct state machine, timer plan, priorities, initial values, scan_execution_order explicit 4-stage, formal_assertions optional. Need include formulas over port names. Need ensure valid JSON. Need consider specifications. Need mention timers? There may be no explicit timers in requirements. But timer_plan required. Could state none / debounce edge timers? Need not invent? Timers required: maybe no PT timers; use edge detection not timers. But key timer_plan list can be empty or include scan-edge detection? They ask timers required, PT durations, reset conditions. Could include edge pulse timers? In PLC, rising edge is not timer. Since no timed requirements, timer_plan: [] with note? JSON structure can have timers array and notes. Need valid JSON, maybe timer_plan: {"timers":[],"notes":"No IEC timers required..."} But key timer_plan should be object perhaps. Need return complete JSON with keys exactly requested. Formal_assertions list of {"id","formula"}; use provided LTL? Need over declared VAR_INPUT/VAR_OUTPUT port names. Could map safe/off etc? Better use raw port names in formulas. They request optional list over declared VAR_INPUT/VAR_OUTPUT port names. We can include assertions with G(...). Use LTL with names like estop, opeMode, valveARun. Need maybe include initial? Formula over ports only, no internal state? They said over declared VAR_INPUT/VAR_OUTPUT port names. We need express invariants. We can include safety: G((estop=FALSE) -> (valveARun=FALSE & ...)). Another: G((opeMode=TRUE & estop=TRUE) -> (at most one actuator?)) But oneActuator not port name? Use expression. Formal assertions can include compound. Need ensure LTL syntax. Could include G((estop = FALSE) -> (...)). Need maybe use /\ or &. The cutoff says optional list. We can include 4 assertions.

Need state_machine list states and transitions. Need support manual and auto modes. Need internal state: phase IDLE, FILL_A, FILL_B, FILL_C, MIX, DRAIN. Maybe manual as separate handled by mode. State machine should include operational phases. Manual not necessarily phase? Could have MANUAL state? Requirements state_machine list states and transitions. We can structure states including IDLE/MANUAL? Need be precise. The auto sequence phases. Manual mode is a mode not phase. State machine could be automatic state machine with phase states. Include mode handling transitions from any auto state to IDLE on estop/mode change. Since one logical phase per invocation.

Need edge sampling stage: detect rising edges of valveAStart etc, autoStart; previous mode; previous estop maybe. Edge history updates during emergency stop so held buttons cannot restart outputs on recovery. Mode change detection after first invocation? Need mention first scan establishes mode. Store prevMode, modeChange = initialized AND (opeMode != prevOpeMode). On first invocation no modeChange. Edge memories update even on mode change/estop. Manual toggles: on rising edge of each button in manual, safe, no modeChange; toggle corresponding latch. Estop false resets all manual latches and auto phase to IDLE; mode change clears latches and sequence and suppresses commands this invocation. In manual, outputs from manual latches? But safety says automatic phases drive only one actuator; independent manual toggles may coexist. Wait safety_priority says "Automatic phases drive only one actuator; independent manual toggles may coexist." P8 says G((safe & opeMode -> oneActuator) & (modeChanged -> off)). So in manual, multiple actuators can be on. In auto, at most one. Need output assignments: if not safe -> all false. Else if modeChange -> all false (mode change clears). Else if opeMode (auto) -> commands from auto phase. Else manual -> commands from manual latches independently. Need mode change first? e-stop first, then mode change. If estop false, off. If modeChange, off. Good.

Auto sequence:
- autoStart rising accepted in IDLE or DRAIN to start fresh batch from FILL_A; processMode latched for active batch. If in DRAIN and fresh autoStart, start new batch. Does valveD remain true until estop/mode switch/fresh autoStart. So if autoStart rising in DRAIN, phase FILL_A and valveD off.
- IDLE: no actuator. autoStart rising -> FILL_A, latch processMode.
- FILL_A: valveA on. When level >=50 -> FILL_B. (One transition per invocation)
- FILL_B: valveB on. When level >=80:
  - if latched processMode=false -> MIX (two-material)
  - if true -> FILL_C (three-material)
- FILL_C: valveC on. When level >=100 -> MIX.
- MIX: mixMotor on. When mixMotorComplete -> DRAIN (stop motor, open D)
- DRAIN: valveD on. Stays until estop false, mode switch to manual, or fresh autoStart rising starts new batch FILL_A. Note autoStart accepted in DRAIN. If autoStart edge in DRAIN, immediately transition to FILL_A? But requirement says fresh autoStart edge is required to restart. One transition per invocation. In DRAIN, if safe & opeMode & rising autoStart -> FILL_A. Then output valveA? Since same scan transition affects observed output. Yes transition affects same observed scan. Need output based on new phase after transition. But edge sampling before. If autoStart in DRAIN, phase becomes FILL_A and valveA true same scan. If also level? likely not. Need ensure not D. Good.

Need manual mode toggles: independent latches for A B C D Mix. But safety priority: estop false turns all off. Mode change clears old latches and sequence. In manual if safe and no modeChange and opeMode=false, rising edges toggle latches; outputs are latches. If held no toggle. In auto, manual latches cleared? On entering auto via mode change, cleared. While auto, manual button edges maybe ignored? Assumptions: manual buttons use rising-edge independent toggles; in manual. In auto no manual toggles. Edge history updates always. Fine.

Need timer_plan. There are no time durations, only level thresholds and mixMotorComplete. Could include no timers. But maybe need "timer_plan": [] or object. Key specified "timer_plan: timers required, PT durations, reset conditions". We'll provide object with timers list empty and notes. But if they expect list, maybe list. "timer_plan": {"timers": [], "reset_conditions": "No timed functions..."} Hmm.

Need initial_values: include valve outputs false, phase IDLE, manual latches false, processModeLatched false, prev input edge memories false, initialized false, prevOpeMode maybe false, modeChange false. Need use names maybe exact variables. Could include outputs plus internals. The key initial_values can be object. Need include estop? inputs not initial. But initial conditions specify outputs and phase. Include internal variables. Good.

Need state_machine: list of states and transitions. Could be array of objects. Need concise. Maybe:
"state_machine": {
 "states": [
   {"name":"IDLE", "outputs":"all OFF", "desc":"..."},
...
 ],
 "transitions": [
   {"from":"ANY","to":"IDLE","condition":"estop=FALSE or modeChange","actions":"clear latches; all outputs OFF"},
   {"from":"IDLE","to":"FILL_A","condition":"safe AND opeMode AND no modeChange AND rising(autoStart)","actions":"latch processMode; valveA ON"},
...
 ]
}
Need "list of states and transitions". Could be object with arrays, okay.

Need mention transitions priority order: estop, modeChange, auto sequence. Need maintain one transition per invocation. In FILL_B the condition branch based latched processMode. Need transitions conditions include "phase=..." and safe etc. Maybe from IDLE to FILL_A if autoStart rising in IDLE. From DRAIN to FILL_A if autoStart rising. Also from DRAIN stays if no events. In DRAIN, if opeMode false (mode switch) modeChange? If mode switch from auto to manual occurs, modeChange true and clear. The transition to manual? State phase IDLE on modeChange. If opeMode false without modeChange? Not possible if prev opeMode false? Actually in DRAIN and opeMode already false? That would mean mode was manual, not auto. The assumption says DRAIN valveD remains TRUE until mode switch to manual (opeMode=FALSE). That is modeChange. Good.

Need include mode-change priority. Edge sampling stage includes: sample all inputs, compute rising edges using previous sampled values, update edge history. Also compute modeChange = initialized && (opeMode != prevOpeMode); update prevOpeMode and initialized after? Need be careful. Stage 1 edge sampling: sample inputs; compute rising edges from prev edge memories; compute modeChange using prevOpeMode and initialized; update prev memories? They say edge history updates during emergency stop. We can update prev memories after computing edges, at end of stage 1. ModeChange computed before updating prevOpeMode. On first invocation initialized false -> modeChange false; then initialized true, prevOpeMode=opeMode. Need mention. Stage 2 safety/reset priority & state transitions: if !estop reset all; else if modeChange clear sequence/latches; else evaluate one state transition (auto) or manual toggle updates? Wait manual toggles are state updates. Scan order stage 2 includes safety/reset priority & state transitions. It can include manual latch toggles? Yes. Stage 3 unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF. No timers, but we still have stage 3: no-op; explicitly no timer FBs. Stage 4 unified output assignments. Good. Need maybe ensure state transitions in stage 2 occur before output stage. Manual latch toggles in stage 2. Auto phase transitions in stage 2. Then output stage computes outputs from final phase/latches after safety/mode gates. This ensures same scan transition affects output. Stage 1 updates edges before stage 2. Outputs assigned stage 4.

Need "priorities": list safety and operational priorities. E-stop > modeChange > manual/auto. Within auto sequence one transition per scan; phase outputs. Manual independent toggles. Maybe mention edge memories update even during e-stop/mode change. Automatic single actuator.

Formal assertions: Use port names only. Need include formulas:
A1 safety: G((estop = FALSE) -> (valveARun = FALSE && valveBRun = FALSE && valveCRun = FALSE && valveDRun = FALSE && mixMotorRun = FALSE))
A2 mode change off? Mode change is internal not port. Can't express over ports unless use prev opeMode? LTL over scan can use prev? They said over declared port names; maybe not internal. Could use X? Hmm. We can omit mode change. A2 auto one actuator: G((estop = TRUE && opeMode = TRUE) -> ((valveARun?1:0)+... <= 1)) but LTL formula with arithmetic maybe okay? Better use pairwise: G((opeMode = TRUE & estop = TRUE) -> !(valveARun & valveBRun) && ... ) for all pairs. That's long but okay. Could use "at most one" as boolean expression. Need formula string can include "at_most_one(...)"? They asked over port names, but macros maybe not. Could include pairwise with logical conjunction. But formula string lengthy. We can include a formula with "G((opeMode = TRUE) -> !(valveARun & valveBRun) & ...)" includes estop? If estop false all off anyway. Use "G((estop = TRUE & opeMode = TRUE) -> (...))". Good.

A3 manual hold? Hard to express without internal rising. Could include no auto actuator overlap. A4 maybe threshold response not directly with internal phase. Could include if levelSensor >=50 then not both A and B? Hmm. Formal assertions optional. We can include just safety invariants. Maybe include initiative initial? They want over inputs/outputs. Initial output all false: "valveARun = FALSE & ..." at initial? But formula over ports with G? Could include initial assertion as "valveARun = FALSE & valveBRun = FALSE & ..." not temporal? They request temporal/invariant assertions. Could use "G(...)" only. Include A1, A2, A3: G((estop=TRUE & opeMode=FALSE) -> (valveARun = X? no)). Manual toggles not express easily. A3: G((estop=FALSE) -> !valveARun & ...). Same. A4: G(levelSensor < 50 -> ...?) Not necessary. Need maybe use names exactly. The formulas don't need to be complete. "optional list". We'll include 3.

Need ensure JSON valid: no comments, no trailing commas. Need escape quotes? Use regular strings. Need maybe formulas with "<="? Valid string. Use "=" and "&". LTL syntax often uses "&&", "->". Fine.

Need include word count? At most 2000 words. Our JSON likely under. Need be concise. But enough detail. Need final only JSON. No markdown. Need maybe no code fences. Return complete JSON.

Let's design final JSON structure:

{
  "state_machine": {
    "states": [
      {"name":"IDLE","description":"Safe initial/auto idle; no auto actuator.",...},
      {"name":"FILL_A","description":"valveARun only in auto; fill to >=50cm."},
...
      {"name":"MANUAL","description":"Not a phase; opeMode=FALSE, manual latches may independently drive any actuator."}
    ],
    "transitions": [
      {"id":"T0","from":"ANY","to":"IDLE","priority":1,"condition":"INITIALIZED AND estop=FALSE","action":"abort batch; clear manual latches; all outputs false"},
      {"id":"T1","from":"ANY","to":"IDLE","priority":2,"condition":"estop=TRUE AND modeChange","action":"clear manual latches/auto sequence; suppress outputs this scan"},
      {"id":"T2","from":"IDLE","to":"FILL_A","priority":3,"condition":"estop=TRUE AND opeMode=TRUE AND rising(autoStart)","action":"latch processMode; phase=FILL_A"},
      {"id":"T3","from":"FILL_A","to":"FILL_B","condition":"estop=TRUE AND opeMode=TRUE AND phase=FILL_A AND levelSensor>=50","action":"close A; open B"},
...
      {"id":"T8","from":"MIX","to":"DRAIN","condition":"... mixMotorComplete","action":"stop mix; open D"},
      {"id":"T9","from":"DRAIN","to":"FILL_A","condition":"... rising(autoStart)","action":"start fresh batch, latch new processMode"},
      {"id":"T10","from":"DRAIN","to":"DRAIN","condition":"else","action":"hold valveDRun"},
      {"id":"TM1","from":"MANUAL","to":"MANUAL","condition":"safe AND !opeMode AND !modeChange AND rising(valveXStart)","action":"toggle latch for actuator X independently"}
    ],
    "notes": "..."
  },
  "timer_plan": {"timers": [], "notes": "No PT timers..."},
  "priorities": [...],
  "initial_values": {...},
  "scan_execution_order": [
    "1. Edge sampling: ...",
    "2. Safety/reset priority & state transitions: ...",
    "3. Unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF: no timer FBs; keep this stage as a no-op in every scan.",
    "4. Unified output assignments: ..."
  ],
  "formal_assertions": [...]
}

Need "state_machine" key says list of states and transitions. Object with lists okay. Could maybe use array with objects each state and transitions? But object with states/transitions is better.

Need include "processModeLatched" initial false. But when autoStart in IDLE/DRAIN, latch processMode. processMode stays latched active batch. Good.

Need mention mode change clears old latches and sequence. Changing operation mode: On first invocation establishes selected mode and executes normally. Mode change after first invocation clears sequence/latches and suppresses commands for that invocation; edge memories still update. So stage 2 if modeChange then clear latches and phase IDLE? The assumptions: "Changing operation mode clears old latches and sequence." Does it set phase IDLE? likely yes. And suppresses commands for that invocation. Then next scan in manual/auto idle. If switching to auto, phase IDLE. If switching to manual, phase IDLE. Good. In state transitions T1 from ANY to IDLE. If modeChange to manual, phase IDLE, manual latches cleared, outputs off. Next scan manual can toggle. Good. If modeChange to auto, phase IDLE, needs autoStart.

Need emergency stop resets all manual latches and automatic state. "phase=IDLE". Estop false triggers reset every scan? If estop false, reset. When estop true again, phase remains IDLE; manual latches cleared. Held buttons cannot restart outputs on recovery because edge memory updated. Good.

Need scan_execution_order stage 2 details: check emergency/mode change first. Then if safe and no modeChange, execute manual toggle or auto transition. Exactly one auto transition per scan. For DRAIN hold if no autoStart. For auto transitions order: use pre-phase stored at start of stage 2. Evaluate based on pre-phase to ensure one transition. Then update phase. If transition and same scan output based on new phase. For DRAIN autoStart transition to FILL_A same scan. For FILL_B branch processModeLatched. Need if in FILL_B and level>=80, transition to MIX or FILL_C. One transition. Good.

Need output stage: First gate: if !estop -> all false; else if modeChange -> all false; else if opeMode -> auto outputs based on phase (only one); else manual outputs = manual latches. But note in auto, manual latches should be clear? Mode change to auto clears; but if manual latches existed before? yes clear. In auto, ignore latches. If estop false then outputs false even if latches? Stage 2 clears latches. Good.
Need if phase IDLE in auto, all false. FILL_A valveA true. FILL_B valveB true. FILL_C valveC. MIX mixMotor. DRAIN valveD. In manual, outputs from manual latches independently, including multiple. If modeChange false and safe. But if in manual and phase may be IDLE after mode switch. Fine.

Timer plan: no timers. Could mention rising edges computed by one-scan previous-state memory, not timers. Reset conditions: edge memories updated every scan including estop/mode change; no PT reset. Good.

Potential issue: "timer_plan: timers required, PT durations, reset conditions" Could include empty list plus "reset_conditions": "N/A". Fine.

{"id":"A2","formula":"G((estop = TRUE & opeMode = TRUE) -> (!(valveARun & valveBRun) & !(valveARun & valveCRun) & !(valveARun & valveDRun) & !(valveARun & mixMotorRun) & !(valveBRun & valveCRun) & !(valveBRun & valveDRun) & !(valveBRun & mixMotorRun) & !(valveCRun & valveDRun) & !(valveCRun & mixMotorRun) & !(valveDRun & mixMotorRun)))"}
{"id":"A3","formula":"G((estop = FALSE) -> (valveARun = FALSE & valveBRun = FALSE & valveCRun = FALSE & valveDRun = FALSE & mixMotorRun = FALSE))"} duplicate. Could use A3 for initial? For example "G((levelSensor < 50) -> !valveBRun)"? But B could be opened manually in manual mode. In auto, B only when A fill done. Not invariant. "G((levelSensor < 80) -> !valveCRun)"? Manual can. Not safe. Formal assertions optional. Include A1/A2 only maybe. They asked optional list. Fine. Maybe include A3 for no actuator in IDLE? Can't express phase. Use A3 for initial output values?
